items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: So they put me in the band, and I didn't know I was going to stay in the band. When I came, we'd come back off the concert tour. I found, they'd say, come in tonight, you know, come in tonight. Next week, come in tonight, same night, so I'd stay here.

ctx.x: And that's when Jaffees did him, was going up I think at Tulane University, because you see, we used to play for all of them way back there, Tulane University. And then they took it over, and it's been successful ever since. That's probably about like 62, like you said. Then they started having concerts, you see, the first one, Iowa, was in Japan, yeah, in 19... No, I went somewhere because I was with George Lou's band, yeah. We played some old Cincinnati, and then St. Paul, the Twin Cities, and a couple other…

Uh-huh. Yeah. And like from, you know, when you came back to New Orleans to about, what was that, 45, I mean, 48 to 65? 48, 48. Yeah. You were, you found, you played quite a bit of music in that time, didn't you?
